upload.title: Upload a meeting
upload.help: Upload a recording (MP3, WAV, MP4, or MOV), a transcript (WebVTT, SRT, plain text, or Markdown), or one of each. A transcript's "Speaker:" names and [00:01:23] times are read when it has them; one with no times and no recording is a meeting in words alone. Large files are sent in parts, and choosing the same files again picks up where an upload stopped.
